The fund made key changes to its holdings this week that included a new stake in a hot semiconductor company and a sale of shares in another trendy name.  A Jan. 8 trading disclosure shows the  added  Broadcom  to its portfolio through the purchase of 31,573 shares, valued at some $10.5 million based on Thursday’s closing price of $332.48.
